description_for_model: EuroRWA tracks tokenized money-market funds (RWA) and produces a daily analyst report with BUY/HOLD/SELL signals, market view, crypto and on-chain briefs. Every report is hashed, signed and attested on-chain (Sepolia). Use /api/overview for the latest report summary, /api/funds and /api/yields for fund data, /api/analytics for institutional metrics, /api/alerts for recent alerts. The full report (POST /api/analyst) requires a $0.05 USDC x402 payment on Base.
description_for_human: EuroRWA Analyst — tokenized money-market fund analysis with on-chain attested reports.
